Curated Bundles

Three hand-picked bundles — tell your budtender which one you want and they'll put it together on the spot.

Browse the MenuContact Us

How It Works

Walk in, pick your bundle, and your budtender assembles it on the spot — no pre-ordering, no guesswork. Available exclusively in-store. Every bundle is tailored to you based on your preferences and what's in stock.

  • From $100

    Head Stash

    Half-zip of the finest flower

    Built for the flower purist. A full half-ounce of high-end indoor — your budtender picks the strain based on your direction. Two pre-rolls for grab-and-go sessions and a full-spectrum edible to round out the experience. This is 14g done right.

    What's in it

    • ½ oz (14g) premium indoor flower — budtender's pick
    • 2 × 1g pre-rolls
    • 1 edible — full-spectrum

  • From $100

    Cloud 9

    All vapor, no compromise

    For the vape and concentrate crowd. A premium cartridge for on-the-go sessions, a concentrate for the real thing at home, and a full-spectrum edible to close it out. Your budtender matches everything to your preferred effect and terpene profile.

    What's in it

    • 1 × 1g cartridge — budtender's pick
    • 1 × 1g concentrate — budtender's pick
    • 1 edible — full-spectrum

  • From $180

    High Roller

    The full ounce. Every format.

    The complete experience — flower and concentrates, maxed out at a full ounce. A half-zip of exotic or limited-run flower plus a quarter of a second premium strain, a cartridge, a concentrate, and a top-shelf edible. Head Stash meets Cloud 9 at the highest tier.

    What's in it

    • ½ oz (14g) exotic or limited-run flower
    • ¼ oz (7g) premium flower — second strain
    • 1 × 1g cartridge — budtender's pick
    • 1 × 1g concentrate — budtender's pick
    • 3 × 1g pre-rolls
    • 1 edible — top-shelf

Exact items vary based on current inventory and budtender recommendation. All bundles subject to availability. In-store only.
